name: Center Shiken Trial: Eigo no Tetsujin
summary:
Center Shiken Trial - Eigo no Tetsujin (English Ironman Center Test Trial) is an educational psx game disc. The game is about learning english language and can be used to complete the basic high school english skills. The game features more than 1600 different words and it covers the four areas of language learning: pronuntiation, writing, grammar and reading comprehension.

The game is divided into 2 different sections. One is about learning in which the game explains different things divided into lessons about english pronuntiation, grammar, etc. The other part is a test in which the player can put his skills to test answering different questions.
